description: Distribution Transformer Convening Content is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The DOE Office of Electricity supported a convening for an industry led effort to investigate reducing the total number of configurations of Distribution Transformers in response to current supply chain and delivery issues. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are energy supply, distribution transformer, transformer core configuration, interchangeability matrix. The portal shows 2025-06-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public_domain). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
